press_references.value: Alkhorayef sole bidder for Saudi wastewater treatment plant project

partnership_announcements.description: Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies is the sole bidder for a wastewater treatment plant project in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, under a 25-year agreement with Saudi Water Partnership Company.
